newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Sept 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Sept 23.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Monday:
* State officials are finding the work requirements of the new welfare law are less onerous than they first believed.
* Republicans and Democrats bickered among themselves about how to divide their funds between the presidential campaign and campaigns for smaller offices.
* Rural communities are seeing a resurgence of population, according to new study.
* By conservative estimates, there are 2,000 to 5,000 unwanted children in Rwanda whose mothers were raped during the civil war and mass killings of 1994, a new report by Human Rights Watch says.
* Roughly 4,000 Moslem volunteers have entered Bosnia from Iran and other Moslem countries in an effort to bolster the religion's presence in the Balkans.
* The head of New York's largest municipal union asked for a moratorium in hiring at the city's "workfare" program.
